title: Rajma (kidney bean curry) with rice and soya yoghurt
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Finely chop the onion, garlic and ginger and fry with the cumin in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Toast the remaining spices for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and cook down for 5 minutes.
Add the rinsed beans and diced tofu and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few beans, then season with salt.
Serve with soya yoghurt, coriander and rice.
